name: How long does it take to paint an interior door?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint an interior door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting an interior door usually takes between 3 to 5 hours of total active labor, spread across 1 to 2 days to account for proper drying. The timeline depends heavily on the door style and prep needs. A flat, hollow-core slab dries quickly and requires minimal brushwork. In contrast, a six-panel wood door requires detailed cutting-in around recessed profiles, filling dents, light sanding between coats, and adequate cure time before hardware can be reinstalled and the door rehung.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting an interior door takes about 3 to 5 hours of hands-on labor, typically completed over 1 to 2 days to allow full drying between coats.
